I am farming my small millet plot here in the North West, like my father did before me. The rains will come soon, and I must prepare. I will buy a little NPK and urea if the agro-dealer has stock and the price is fair, but my plot is small so I cannot afford much. I keep some goats and chickens, so their manure goes on the field, and I will use my own seed saved from last harvest because improved millet seed is hard to find and costly. My sons and I will do most of the work ourselves, but at weeding time I may call two or three young men from the village to help for a few days.
